product.title: Fort Lauderdale Sailing Charter

description.text: This half-day Fort Lauderdale sailing experience is ideal for visitors who want to get out on the water without having to drive a boat themselves. This relaxing, small-group experience takes you down the scenic New River, dubbed the "Venice of America," lined with mangroves and waterfront homes, down to Port Everglades. Take in the sights as you chat amongst yourselves. Ideal for groups on Fort Lauderdale's Intracoastal Waterway who want a private captain without handling marina logistics.
